title: Code hanging when exception raised during commit in async code

labels.name: external driver issues
labels.description: the issue involves a misbehavior on the part of the DBAPI itself, probably not SQLAlchemy

body:
### Discussed in https://github.com/sqlalchemy/sqlalchemy/discussions/12727
Originally posted by **coby-astsec** July 10, 2025 # Summary Hi, Opening a discussion as per the instructions when creating an issue. When running multiple async INSERTS at the same time, if an `asyncio.CancelledError` is raised, some(?) commits in progress are not cancelled. This happened when we had code in the form of: ```python task1 = insert_many_to_table_a() task2 = insert_many_to_table_b() task3 = insert_many_to_table_c() await asyncio.gather(task1, task2, task3) ``` If task3 would raise an exception while a commit in task1 or task2 is in progress (for any reason, but for us here it was a constraint issue), then the code hangs forever. # Reproducible example: The example reproduces 9/10 times for me. Create a table: ```sql CREATE TABLE delayed_commit (id uuid PRIMARY KEY, magic INT); ``` The code can be run with: ```bash DATABASE_URL="postgresql+asyncpg://postgres:postgres@localhost:5432/postgres" uv run --script example.py ``` (and of course can be run without uv by installing the dependencies listed at the top of the file) ```python # /// script # requires-python = ">=3.13" # dependencies = [ # "asyncpg", # "sqlalchemy[asyncio]", # ] # /// import asyncio import os import uuid from sqlalchemy.ext.asyncio import async_sessionmaker from sqlalchemy.ext.asyncio import create_async_engine from sqlalchemy.orm import DeclarativeBase, mapped_column from sqlalchemy.orm.attributes import Mapped from sqlalchemy.sql.sqltypes import Uuid, Integer DATABASE_URL = os.getenv('DATABASE_URL') engine = create_async_engine(DATABASE_URL, pool_size=1, echo=False) Session = async_sessionmaker(engine, expire_on_commit=False) semaphore = asyncio.Semaphore(2) class Base(DeclarativeBase): pass class DelayedCommit(Base): """ CREATE TABLE delayed_commit (id uuid PRIMARY KEY, magic INT); """ __tablename__ = 'delayed_commit' id: Mapped[uuid.UUID] = mapped_column(Uuid, primary_key=True) magic: Mapped[int] = mapped_column(Integer) async def long_commit_task(magic: int): async with semaphore: async with Session() as session: print("Adding to delayed_commit...") for i in range(100000): session.add(DelayedCommit(id=uuid.uuid4(), magic=magic)) print("Commiting") await session.commit() print("COMMIT done") async def crashing_task(): async with semaphore: print("Failing!") raise ValueError("Another task failed while we were committing") async def main(): tasks = [] for i in range(3): tasks.append(asyncio.create_task(long_commit_task(i))) tasks.append(asyncio.create_task(crashing_task())) await asyncio.gather(*tasks) if __name__ == "__main__": asyncio.run(main()) ``` The output will look like this: ```bash ❯ DATABASE_URL="postgresql+asyncpg://postgres:postgres@localhost:5432/postgres" uv run --script a.py Adding to delayed_commit... Commiting Adding to delayed_commit... Commiting COMMIT done Adding to delayed_commit... Commiting COMMIT done Failing! ``` And then hang forever. Once I interrupt with Ctrl+C: ```python Traceback (most recent call last): File "/uv/python/cpython-3.13.3-macos-aarch64-none/lib/python3.13/asyncio/runners.py", line 195, in run return runner.run(main) ~~~~~~~~~~^^^^^^ File "/uv/python/cpython-3.13.3-macos-aarch64-none/lib/python3.13/asyncio/runners.py", line 118, in run return self._loop.run_until_complete(task) ~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~^^^^^^ File "/uv/python/cpython-3.13.3-macos-aarch64-none/lib/python3.13/asyncio/base_events.py", line 719, in run_until_complete return future.result() ~~~~~~~~~~~~~^^ File "/example.py", line 59, in main await asyncio.gather(*tasks) File "/example.py", line 50, in crashing_task raise ValueError("Another task failed while we were committing") ValueError: Another task failed while we were committing During handling of the above exception, another exception occurred: Traceback (most recent call last): File "/example.py", line 63, in asyncio.run(main()) ~~~~~~~~~~~^^^^^^^^ File "/uv/python/cpython-3.13.3-macos-aarch64-none/lib/python3.13/asyncio/runners.py", line 194, in run with Runner(debug=debug, loop_factory=loop_factory) as runner: ~~~~~~^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^ File "/uv/python/cpython-3.13.3-macos-aarch64-none/lib/python3.13/asyncio/runners.py", line 62, in __exit__ self.close() ~~~~~~~~~~^^ File "/uv/python/cpython-3.13.3-macos-aarch64-none/lib/python3.13/asyncio/runners.py", line 70, in close _cancel_all_tasks(loop) ~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~^^^^^^ File "/uv/python/cpython-3.13.3-macos-aarch64-none/lib/python3.13/asyncio/runners.py", line 206, in _cancel_all_tasks loop.run_until_complete(tasks.gather(*to_cancel, return_exceptions=True)) ~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^ File "/uv/python/cpython-3.13.3-macos-aarch64-none/lib/python3.13/asyncio/base_events.py", line 706, in run_until_complete self.run_forever() ~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~^^ File "/uv/python/cpython-3.13.3-macos-aarch64-none/lib/python3.13/asyncio/base_events.py", line 677, in run_forever self._run_once() ~~~~~~~~~~~~~~^^ File "/uv/python/cpython-3.13.3-macos-aarch64-none/lib/python3.13/asyncio/base_events.py", line 1996, in _run_once event_list = self._selector.select(timeout) File "/uv/python/cpython-3.13.3-macos-aarch64-none/lib/python3.13/selectors.py", line 548, in select kev_list = self._selector.control(None, max_ev, timeout) KeyboardInterrupt ``` When querying Postgres, it looks like Postgres is waiting for the client to send more data: ```sql SELECT pid, wait_event, query, query_start FROM pg_stat_activity WHERE state IS NOT NULL AND pid != PG_BACKEND_PID(); ``` | pid | wait\_event | query | query\_start | | :--- | :--- | :--- | :--- | | 28833 | ClientRead | INSERT INTO delayed\_commit \(id, magic\) VALUES \($1::UUID, $2::INTEGER\) | 2025-07-10 19:39:37.038667 +00:00 | | 28834 | ClientRead | COMMIT; | 2025-07-10 19:39:35.867416 +00:00 | And when checking if the data itself is committed, one of the values will have not been inserted: ```sql SELECT DISTINCT magic FROM delayed_commit; ``` | magic | | :--- | | 0 | | 1 | # Extra details ## Package versions ``` sqlalchemy v2.0.41 asyncpg v0.30.0 ``` ## Database Postgres 17 with `asyncpg` driver ## Python version 3.13 ## Operating system MacOS + Linux (arm64)
